understanding.goal_understanding: Progress through all KA59 levels by moving/selecting pieces so that every goal tile marked '+' is occupied by a selectable piece at the same time; a level is won only when all goals are simultaneously covered, and the full game is won by achieving WIN on the final level within the per-level step budget.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each turn controls the currently selected piece (identified by player.id/position). MOVE_* attempts to shift that piece by one grid cell (3 pixels per cell) in the chosen direction; movement can be blocked or altered by walls/boundaries and by interactions when adjacent objects exist. Pushable blocks can be moved if directly adjacent in the movement direction, potentially shifting together with the selected piece if space allows; walls generally prevent movement and pushes, though boundaries can behave inconsistently so testing is sometimes required. If multiple selectables exist, control switches via CLICK on the other selectable's exact pixel/grid coordinate listed in objects/selectables (not semantic cell indices). The movement.*_blocked flags are only hints that something is adjacent and do not guarantee a move will fail.
